info.name: BeatX Safe Public Smoke - no writes
info.description: BeatX handoff 2026-11-14. Generated from current controller/DTO metadata. API_CHANGES_FOR_APPS.md is the migration guide. Whole BDT paisa, gateway payments (dummy only), no Stripe. Import the accompanying environment; enter your own test credentials/tokens and IDs. Do not bulk-run this full collection: writes, deletions, OTP sends and play-counting GETs are intentional actions. Run BeatX-SafeSmoke for safe public/guard checks. Saved responses are illustrative schemas, not live captures. Generic/dynamic response objects are intentionally open; use the guide for their semantics.

Social sign-in providers this server can complete on the website

A provider is listed only when its credentials and OAUTH_WEB_REDIRECT_URL are set, so clients hide buttons that would end on a provider error page.
